title: Lunar laser ranging to the Apollo 15 reflector, 2015-2025: passes of 6 h or more (EDC/DGFI normal points)
verdict_rule: Passes whose ranges are as smooth with R = 0 as with any other value.
license_note: EDC (DGFI-TUM) open archive of ILRS normal points: free, cite ILRS / EDC.

sources.cite: EUROLAS Data Center (DGFI-TUM), ILRS lunar laser ranging normal points (CRD), Apollo 15 reflector

units.tof: s, two-way time of flight (record type 11)

inputs.origin: EDC (DGFI-TUM) ILRS normal points, Apollo 15 reflector, monthly files 2015-2025 (fog fetch moon-llr).

notes: Only times and times of flight are kept: nothing about the Earth's shape. The section that fits the radius is a check because of what the page adds (the Moon's direction from a lunar theory, the ellipsoid's flattening), not because of these data. fog fetch moon-llr gets the monthly files of 2015-2025 (Years in tools/internal/build/llr).
